resumo: 3D web experience to explore the Milky Way, with 22 astronomical destinations and curated scientific content.

estudoDeCaso.problema: Astronomy content is usually in long texts or in simulators that are hard to use. The goal was a visual way, in Portuguese, to explore the Milky Way with reliable information.
decisoes: Three.js with React to render the 3D scene and keep the interface organized in components.
Vite and TypeScript for fast builds and strict typing.
Scientific content curated from institutional sources.
Support for reduced motion and high contrast mode from the start.
estudoDeCaso.resultado: App published on Vercel with 22 astronomical destinations, unit tests and accessibility features.
estudoDeCaso.aprendizado: Balancing 3D graphics with accessibility and organizing scientific content for non-experts.

usoDeIA.texto: Built with Claude Code from a CLAUDE.md holding the project's principles, architecture and commands; AGENTS.md only points to it. Each phase followed a plan under docs/superpowers/plans, executed task by task with TDD. A project skill, /verify, runs tests, build and lint before any change is declared done, and a hook in .claude/settings.json runs the linter after every edit.
